# korean-word-of-the-day — static word bank and date-pinned rotation

| name | kind | database/location | purpose | migration filename |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `window.KOREAN_WORDS` | in-memory array | `words.js` | word bank of 20 entries, each with `ko`, `roman`, `sound`, `pos`, `meaning`, `syl`, `ex` fields | N/A |

## Access

No database, role, or grant. The word bank is a global `window.KOREAN_WORDS` array in `words.js`, loaded by `index.html` in the browser. No secrets are stored or accessed.

## Env keys

N/A: no environment keys are defined or read.

## External integrations

N/A: no APIs, devices, or other services are called. Rotation is deterministic by local calendar date with no network.

## Consumers

- `index.html` — renders the word of the day and word clock from `window.KOREAN_WORDS`.
- Browser kiosk — displays the resting screen at 1280×800 or similar, per the README.
